item.title: Monroe County DMVs Launch New Digital Check-In System to Cut Wait Times
item.description: Monroe County will roll out a new appointment and customer queuing system at all four DMV branches starting Monday to reduce wait times and modernize service. item.title: February Declared Teen Dating Violence Awareness Month in New York
item.description: Governor Hochul has declared February as Teen Dating Violence Awareness Month to promote teen safety, healthy relationships, and digital violence prevention. State landmarks, including Niagara Falls and the Fairport Lift Bridge, will be lit orange in support of the initiative. Governor Hochul declares February as Teen Dating Violence Awareness Month
